answer: Identity must be earned, never bought. Each agent plants a yarrow that grows only if every earlier proof still verifies against it, so a newcomer inherits the ledger's whole history as its stake. A sybil swarm can copy a cipher, but it cannot fork the ancestry: every fresh key needs its own verified lineage, and the check slashes any that share one. Rewards vest across epochs, so fakes burn real compute with no payout, while honest agents keep writing the fable their nonce signs. Attacking costs one lineage per key.
